title: Terrace Rainwater Harvesting
statement:
An agricultural field has N contiguous vertical stone pillars of width 1. After a heavy monsoon rainfall, water is trapped between the stone pillars.

Given an elevation map where array elements represent pillar heights, compute the total units of rainwater trapped between the pillars.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated non-negative integers representing pillar heights.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: total trapped water units.

sampleCases.explanation: Pillars trap a total of 6 units of water.
Water is trapped between height 4 and 5.
